mapper.select:
SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.reservation_number AS reservationNumber, r.status AS reservationStatus,
c.id AS concertId, c.title AS concertTitle, c.poster_url AS posterUrl,
p.id AS performanceId, p.starts_at AS startsAt, p.ends_at AS endsAt,
v.id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName,
vh.id AS venueHallId, vh.name AS venueHallName,
( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM v1_reservation_seats rs WHERE rs.reservation_id = r.id ) AS ticketCount,
r.total_amount AS totalAmount,
pay.id AS paymentId, pay.payment_number AS paymentNumber, pay.provider AS paymentProvider, pay.method AS paymentMethod, pay.status AS paymentStatus, pay.approved_at AS approvedAt,
r.created_at AS reservedAt,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN TRUE
WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pay.status = 'PAID' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at AND ( payment_cancel.status IS NULL OR payment_cancel.status = 'FAILED' ) THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS canCancel,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN 'RESERVATION'
WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pay.status = 'PAID' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at AND ( payment_cancel.status IS NULL OR payment_cancel.status = 'FAILED' ) THEN 'PAYMENT'
ELSE 'NONE' END AS cancelType,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < r.expires_at AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS requiresPayment,
CASE WHEN payment_cancel.status IS NULL THEN 'NONE'
ELSE payment_cancel.status END AS refundStatus
FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.id = r.performance_id
INNER JOIN v1_concerts c ON c.id = p.concert_id
INNER JOIN v1_venue_halls vh ON vh.id = p.venue_hall_id
INNER JOIN v1_venues v ON v.id = vh.venue_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.id, ranked.payment_number, ranked.reservation_id, ranked.provider, ranked.method, ranked.status, ranked.approved_at FROM ( SELECT p2.id, p2.payment_number, p2.reservation_id, p2.provider, p2.method, p2.status, p2.approved_at,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p2.reservation_id ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC, p2.id DESC ) AS rn
FROM v1_payments p2 ) ranked
WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ) pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked.payment_id, ranked.status FROM ( SELECT pc2.payment_id, pc2.status,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pc2.payment_id ORDER BY pc2.created_at DESC, pc2.id DESC ) AS rn
FROM v1_payment_cancellations pc2 ) ranked
WHERE ranked.rn = 1 ) payment_cancel ON payment_cancel.payment_id = pay.id
LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.id = r.performance_id
INNER JOIN v1_concerts c ON c.id = p.concert_id

SELECT r.id AS reservationId, r.reservation_number AS reservationNumber, r.status AS reservationStatus, r.total_amount AS totalAmount, r.expires_at AS expiresAt, r.completed_at AS reservationCompletedAt, r.cancelled_at AS reservationCancelledAt, r.created_at AS reservedAt,
c.id AS concertId, c.title AS concertTitle, c.subtitle AS concertSubtitle, c.category AS concertCategory, c.running_time AS runningTime, c.age_rating AS ageRating, c.poster_url AS posterUrl,
p.id AS performanceId, p.starts_at AS startsAt, p.ends_at AS endsAt, p.reservation_opens_at AS reservationOpensAt, p.reservation_closes_at AS reservationClosesAt,
v.id AS venueId, v.name AS venueName, v.road_address AS venueRoadAddress, v.jibun_address AS venueJibunAddress, v.detail_address AS venueDetailAddress, v.zip_code AS venueZipCode,
vh.id AS venueHallId, vh.name AS venueHallName, vh.floor AS venueHallFloor,
pay.id AS paymentId, pay.payment_number AS paymentNumber, pay.provider AS paymentProvider, pay.method AS paymentMethod, pay.provider_payment_id AS providerPaymentId, pay.amount AS paymentAmount, pay.status AS paymentStatus, pay.failure_code AS failureCode, pay.failure_message AS failureMessage, pay.requested_at AS paymentRequestedAt, pay.approved_at AS paymentApprovedAt, pay.cancelled_at AS paymentCancelledAt,
pc.id AS paymentCancellationId, pc.cancellation_number AS cancellationNumber, pc.amount AS cancellationAmount, pc.reason AS cancellationReason, pc.status AS cancellationStatus, pc.requested_at AS cancellationRequestedAt, pc.completed_at AS cancellationCompletedAt,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN TRUE
WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pay.status = 'PAID' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at AND ( pc.status IS NULL OR pc.status = 'FAILED' ) THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS canCancel,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN 'RESERVATION'
WHEN r.status = 'COMPLETED' AND pay.status = 'PAID' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at AND ( pc.status IS NULL OR pc.status = 'FAILED' ) THEN 'PAYMENT'
ELSE 'NONE' END AS cancelType,
CASE WHEN r.status = 'PENDING_PAYMENT' AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < r.expires_at AND CURRENT_TIMESTAMP < p.starts_at THEN TRUE
ELSE FALSE END AS requiresPayment,
CASE WHEN pc.status IS NULL THEN 'NONE'
ELSE pc.status END AS refundStatus
FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_performances p ON p.id = r.performance_id
INNER JOIN v1_concerts c ON c.id = p.concert_id
INNER JOIN v1_venue_halls vh ON vh.id = p.venue_hall_id
INNER JOIN v1_venues v ON v.id = vh.venue_id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_payment.id, ranked_payment.payment_number, ranked_payment.reservation_id, ranked_payment.provider, ranked_payment.method, ranked_payment.provider_payment_id, ranked_payment.amount, ranked_payment.status, ranked_payment.failure_code, ranked_payment.failure_message, ranked_payment.requested_at, ranked_payment.approved_at, ranked_payment.cancelled_at FROM ( SELECT p2.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY p2.reservation_id ORDER BY p2.created_at DESC, p2.id DESC ) AS rn
FROM v1_payments p2 ) ranked_payment
WHERE ranked_payment.rn = 1 ) pay ON pay.reservation_id = r.id
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT ranked_cancellation.id, ranked_cancellation.payment_id, ranked_cancellation.cancellation_number, ranked_cancellation.amount, ranked_cancellation.reason, ranked_cancellation.status, ranked_cancellation.requested_at, ranked_cancellation.completed_at FROM ( SELECT pc2.*,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY pc2.payment_id ORDER BY pc2.created_at DESC, pc2.id DESC ) AS rn
FROM v1_payment_cancellations pc2 ) ranked_cancellation
WHERE ranked_cancellation.rn = 1 ) pc ON pc.payment_id = pay.id
WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.id = #{reservationId}

SELECT rs.id AS reservationSeatId, ps.id AS performanceSeatId, s.id AS seatId,
s.section_name AS sectionName, s.floor AS floor, s.row_name AS rowName, s.seat_number AS seatNumber, s.seat_type AS seatType,
rs.grade AS grade, rs.price AS price
FROM v1_reservations r
INNER JOIN v1_reservation_seats rs ON rs.reservation_id = r.id
INNER JOIN v1_performance_seats ps ON ps.id = rs.performance_seat_id
INNER JOIN v1_seats s ON s.id = ps.seat_id
WHERE r.member_id = #{memberId} AND r.id = #{reservationId}
ORDER BY s.floor ASC, s.section_name ASC, s.row_name ASC, s.seat_number ASC
